name: Langston Golf Course
location: Kingman Lake, Washington, District of Columbia
architects: George Parish (front nine, 1939, built by the CCC and WPA); back nine added 1955

dtm.source: District of Columbia (OCTO / DC GIS) lidar bare-earth DEM, 1 m, NAD83(HARN) / Maryland State Plane (EPSG:2804), metres; DC-wide file DC.TIF.2.tif from the developer (GitHub release data-washington-dc), clipped to the world + 100 m with pipeline/clip_raster.py

chm.source: District of Columbia (OCTO / DC GIS) lidar normalized digital surface model (height above ground), 1 m, EPSG:2804, metres, water = -5; DC-wide file DC.TIF.1.tif from the developer (GitHub release data-washington-dc), clipped with pipeline/clip_raster.py
chm.label: DC lidar normalized surface model

world.note: bbox of the OSM course boundary (both parts: 1287 x 1323 m) + scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks: 1536 x 1536 m (~124 m east and west, ~107 m south and north)

scorecard_source: Club scorecard PDF (National Links Trust, 'langston.scorecard.pdf', GitHub release data-langston, supplied by the developer 2026-10-19; copy in reference/langston/): pars, handicaps and yardages for Royal, White, Gold and Wake-Robin. The card prints no ratings; ratings/slopes from GolfPass (course 4511), retrieved 2026-10-19, unverified (Wake-Robin 69.6/111 is the women's rating). Royal is the developer's 'Blue' tee and the default (2026-10-19).

join_boundary.note: OSM maps the course as two polygons (the mainland, holes 1-9 and 14-18, and Kingman Island, holes 10-13) with Kingman Lake between them. The game's out-of-bounds line is one polygon, so the lake between the two parts (the part of it inside their convex hull, marsh islands included) joins them and is a red penalty area (developer, 2026-10-19: option A, red for all water).

green_tiers.note: developer 2026-10-19: tiered green, the front little bit about 4-5 ft below the back, the back portion bigger; modelled as a 1.37 m (4.5 ft) step across the line of play, 30% of the green's depth from its front edge, pin in the middle of the upper (back) tier

attribution: Elevation and canopy: District of Columbia lidar 1 m DEM and normalized surface model, DC GIS / OCTO (CC BY 4.0)
Scorecard: Langston Golf Course (National Links Trust)
notes: Developer decisions 2026-10-19: Royal (Blue) tees default; hole 10 has a back tee across Kingman Lake on the front-nine side; boundary joined across the lake (option A); every water hazard red; fairways run up to the green on every hole except where water lies between; anacostia theme with murky river water, no blossoms; the driving range is not made out of bounds. Hole 13 has a two-tier green (small low front tier), developer 2026-10-19.
